Contract fixture, synthetic: the divisional window shape (bead tl-4sg.40, ruling 2026-09-04), the Conference Carolinas move of North Greenville from its Southwest division (2023) to Northwest (2024 onward) restamped onto the SSC code, because the fixture's conference list must equal the packaged file's and CC lands with its batch 4 windows. A division change splits the window with the conference unchanged; division is the string the conference prints.
